title: 2020 AMC 10A Problem 5
statement: What is the sum of all real numbers \(x\) for which \[|x^2-12x+34|=2?\]

solutions.text: The equation means \(x^2-12x+34=2\) or \(x^2-12x+34=-2\). The first gives \(x^2-12x+32=0\), with roots \(4\) and \(8\). The second gives \((x-6)^2=0\), with root \(6\). The sum of all real solutions is \(4+8+6=18\). Thus, C is the correct answer.
hints: Split the absolute-value equation into two quadratic equations
Remember to count the double root only once in the sum of real numbers
